title: Revenue per product
prompt: Return each product and its total revenue (quantity * unit_price, summed) as a column named revenue.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE line_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product TEXT, quantity INTEGER, unit_price REAL); INSERT INTO line_items VALUES (1,'Widget',3,10.0),(2,'Gadget',1,25.0),(3,'Widget',2,10.0),(4,'Gizmo',5,8.0),(5,'Gadget',2,25.0);
reference_sql: SELECT product, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS revenue FROM line_items GROUP BY product;
